tip.cash: Money in the bank. Sales minus parts, rent and late-night development.
tip.brand: Brand (0–100). Good reviews push it up, and a strong brand sells every phone a little easier.
tip.fans: Fans pre-order at launch. Every well-reviewed phone wins a few more.
tip.date: Game time. At 1× a day takes 5 seconds.
tip.design: Design 0–10: material, thinness, screen-to-body, size, color and proportions – judged against what people expect this year.
tip.tech: Tech 0–10: chip, display, battery, camera, storage and RAM – judged against what the market expects this year.
tip.review: Where the critics will probably land (±0.5). Better reviews sell a lot more phones.
tip.unitCost: What one phone costs you: parts, plastic, assembly, box.
tip.price: Shelf price. Set to a fair value for now – you get to pick it once you have an office.
tip.margin: What you keep from each phone sold.
tip.devTime: Game days until the prototype works (you, alone, at a workbench).
tip.devCost: Parts and prototypes. Paid up front.
tip.weekly: Likely sales in the first weeks. The garage can hand-build 50 phones a week.

tutorial.color: Okay. First decision of the empire: what color is it?
tutorial.shape: Nice. Now the silhouette – soft, sharp or skinny?
tutorial.display: Screen size. Bigger looks great. The battery will hate you for it.
tutorial.launch: It works. Mostly. Smash the button.

launch.overnight: Coffee number seven. Soldering. Questionable decisions.

good.color: THAT COLOR! We'd steal it off a table.
good.shape: Feels like it was carved for a human hand. WOW.
good.thin: SO thin it slid out of our pocket. Worth it.
good.display: Screen size? Spot on. No notes.
good.battery: Battery lasted our whole office party. And the after-party.
good.price: Cheap AND good? Who let this happen?

bad.color: That color is giving… last year.
bad.shape: Holding it feels like holding a doorstop.
bad.thin: CHUNKY. We used it as a paperweight.
bad.screen: Bezels you could park a car on.
bad.display: The screen size is just… odd.
bad.performance: Opened an app. Made a sandwich. Still loading.

good.color: A palette with genuine restraint – rare at this price.
good.thin: A lesson in slimness, without the compromise.
good.screen: The display reads as one calm, unbroken surface.
good.display: Its size feels considered, not chased.
good.battery: Endurance that lets you forget about the charger.

bad.color: The color choice feels like a committee's.
bad.screen: Too much frame, too little picture.
bad.battery: Anxious about its own battery, and so are we.
bad.price: Ambitiously priced for what it is.

good.display: panel size within optimal range for segment.
good.performance: benchmark: top of its class. no throttling.

bad.thin: caliper reading: thick. segment avg is thinner.
bad.price: price/perf ratio: poor. wait for a sale.

teaser.office: {amount} more and you can stop working in a garage.
teaser.secondLaunch: One phone is a fluke. Two is a company. Build the next one.
teaser.officeReady: You can afford a real office. Hiring and research arrive in the next update.

toast.noCash: Not enough cash for the prototype parts.
toast.devDone: Prototype works. Mostly. Ready to launch!
toast.officeReady: You can afford a real office now!
